intro: Tanzania has Africa's highest mountain, its largest lake and some of its greatest wildlife parks.

chapters.title: Mountains and lakes
text: Kilimanjaro, 5,895 m, is Africa's highest peak and the world's tallest free-standing mountain. Tanzania borders Lake Victoria, Lake Tanganyika (the second-deepest lake in the world) and Lake Malawi (Nyasa).
The Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater teem with wildlife.

chapters.title: Coast and islands
text: The coast has coral reefs, and Zanzibar, Pemba and Mafia islands lie offshore.

keyTerms.meaning: A bowl-shaped hollow, often from an old volcano.
